APPROVE
`JudgeAsync` now has roughly 10–11 flat branches, the extracted steps keep the same check order, outcomes, reasons and verdict fields (including `CorpusPin = headPin` and the null delta when the bench cannot be measured), and every helper only uses values in its own scope; I checked this by reading the diff, not by building, so I could not confirm the unseen engine-test lines or analyzer rules under warnings-as-errors.
